items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: met Elaine, which was the major factor in my being as successful as I've been up to this point

ctx.x: When I finally settled with the drug problem, kicked that in the ass, I discovered that I had to start all over from the very beginning. Telephones wouldn't answer to me, people weren't in to me and this was pretty much warranted. I earned it by being untrustworthy, undependable and an addict, and so I started from the beginning.

I went back rejoined the union, met Elaine, which was the major factor in my being as successful as I've been up to this point, in coming back, in coming back to life. But I had to do it by going out to Staten Island on Saturday nights and working in a little, dingy joint under scale, and I had a day job as a messenger

delivering packages, making forty three dollars a week that way, but it was all important, all very important. It was a way of me beginning to believe in myself that I was a man, that I could be depended on, be responsible.
